title: Two-Stage Score Estimation for Group-Specific Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative modeling across related distributions raises a question: how can shared structure support accurate generation for a target distribution with limited observations? We develop a statistical framework for diffusion transfer that analyzes a shared pooled score together with a target-specific offset. Under Besov regularity of the pooled density and a stable hierarchical composition model for the offset, we derive convergence rates that separate the costs of learning these components and identify when a simpler offset yields a faster risk-bound rate than separate fitting. Under suitable boundary and regularity assumptions, we prove that the offset remains bounded and jointly regular as diffusion time approaches zero. These results allow the lower time cutoff to vanish polynomially and provide total-variation guarantees for diffusion models as density estimators. Synthetic simulations and image benchmarks provide a proof of concept

translated_title: 面向群体特定扩散模型的两阶段得分估计
translated_abstract: 跨相关分布的生成建模提出了一个问题：共享结构如何在观测有限的情况下支持对目标分布的准确生成？我们开发了一个用于扩散迁移的统计框架，分析共享的池化得分与目标特定的偏移量。在池化密度满足Besov正则性以及偏移量满足稳定分层复合模型的条件下，我们推导出能够分离学习这两个组件成本的收敛速率，并识别出何时更简单的偏移量可以产生比单独拟合更快的风险界速率。在适当的边界和正则性假设下，我们证明随着扩散时间趋于零，偏移量保持有界且具有联合正则性。这些结果使得下时间截断能够以多项式方式趋于消失，并为扩散模型作为密度估计器提供了全变差保证。合成模拟和图像基准测试提供了概念验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对群体特定扩散模型的两阶段得分估计统计框架，通过将共享池化得分与目标特定偏移量分离分析，推导出收敛速率，并证明扩散模型可作为密度估计器获得全变差保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage score estimation framework for group-specific diffusion models that separates a shared pooled score from a target-specific offset, deriving convergence rates and providing total-variation guarantees for diffusion models as density estimators.
